title: papaver radicatum subsp. steindorssonianum
intro: Papaver radicatum subsp. steindorssonianum, commonly known as Steindorsson's poppy or Icelandic poppy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the poppy family. It is a perennial plant native to Iceland, used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Papaver radicatum subsp. steindorssonianum include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, making it useful for treating various conditions such as arthritis. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and flavonoids.
